fields.title: CAIPO search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Successful records carry company_name/company_number/registration_category/registration_date exactly as returned by CAIPO's searchDbApi -- the entirety of what the free public search exposes (no directors/officers/status/detail endpoint exists; a fuller profile requires a paid $5 manual 'Company Inquiry' outside this actor's scope).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name, registration number, or empty string for a category-only search) that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_totalAvailable.title: Total matches available
_totalAvailable.description: Total number of rows CAIPO reports matching this query (may exceed the number of records emitted if maxResultsPerQuery capped it).

_truncated.title: Truncated upstream
_truncated.description: True if CAIPO itself capped the match count at 2,000 rows before this actor's own maxResultsPerQuery was applied -- refine the query/category to see the rest.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), search_api_error (upstream rejected the query), blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

company_name.title: Company name
company_name.description: Registered entity/business name, exactly as held by CAIPO.

company_number.title: Registration number
company_number.description: CAIPO registration number. NOTE: not a unique per-entity key -- CAIPO reuses numbers across amalgamations/re-registrations/name changes, so the same number can appear on multiple rows with different company_name values.

registration_category.title: Register category
registration_category.description: Which CAIPO register this entry sits in (e.g. DOMESTIC REGISTER, BUSINESS NAMES, INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS COMPANY, CHARITY REGISTER). Can be null for some legacy rows.

registration_date.title: Registration date
registration_date.description: Date registered (YYYY-MM-DD), as held by CAIPO. A literal "0" means CAIPO has no recorded date for that entry (seen on old/legacy rows) -- passed through raw, not normalized.
